zh.summary: 精简便携版与官方 DSH 之间的兼容层，继续独立更新便携程序与内核。
highlights: 会话导出、主题初始化和新版内核的插件管理使用官方实现。Windows 仍可使用系统对话框保存导出文件。
移除未使用的工作区标题栏补丁，保留新版内核所需的启动、设置和浏览器登录兼容性。
upgradeNotes: Windows 在线升级会保留当前选择的内核。要切换到独立发布的 DSH 0.2.2-rc.3，请使用设置中的内核更新。
离线整包需要与当前内核版本一致。从 0.9.10 或更早版本首次升级时，请用本页的 Windows 便携启动器更新现有文件夹。
acknowledgements: 感谢 DeepSeek Harness 团队及贡献者维护官方客户端和内核。

en.summary: Simplifies the integration with official DSH and keeps Portable and core updates independent.
highlights: Use official session export, theme initialization, and plugin management on newer cores. Windows still offers the system dialog for saving exports.
Remove an unused workspace header patch and keep startup, settings, and browser sign-in compatible with newer cores.
upgradeNotes: Online Windows upgrades preserve the selected core. To switch to the separately delivered DSH 0.2.2-rc.3, use Core Updates in Settings.
Full offline packages must match the current core. For a first upgrade from 0.9.10 or earlier, use the Windows portable launcher from this page to update the existing folder.
acknowledgements: Thanks to the DeepSeek Harness team and contributors for maintaining the official client and core.
